 Live SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 LIVE: Junior Associate pre scorecard expected today; merit list, main exam dates
 Soumi Roy | November 18, 2026 | 06:07 AM IST | 5 mins read
 The State Bank of India is expected to announce the Junior Associate preliminary examination result today; candidates can check the result PDF, scorecard, and category-wise cut-offs
 SBI Clerk JA Scorecard soon at sbi.bank.in. (Representative Image: Pexels) The State Bank of India (SBI) will announce the SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 for Junior Associate (Customer Support and Sales) posts soon. After the declaration of the SBI Clerk Result 2026, candidates will be able to check their qualifying status on the official website, sbi.bank.in.
 SBI Clerk:  Sample papers  |   Preparation tips 
 The SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 will be released in PDF format, while individual scorecards and category-wise cut-off marks will be shared separately. The IBPS Clerk Prelims admit card 2026 was released on October 2.
 Once the SBI Junior Associate Result 2026 link is activated, candidates must keep their registration number and password or date of birth to access their marks. Candidates who qualify in the prelims examination can appear for the IBPS Clerk Mains exam 2026.
 Also read Where are the bank jobs? Finance still hiring, just not where commerce graduates are looking 
 How to check SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026?
 Candidates can follow these steps once the result link is activated:
 Visit the official SBI website at sbi.bank.in.
 On the homepage, find and open the Careers section.
 Click on Current Openings.
 Find the Junior Associate recruitment notification (CRPD/CR/2026-27/17).
 Click on the SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 link.
 Download the result PDF and search for your roll number.
 For individual marks, candidates can open the scorecard link and enter their login credentials.
 Also read IBPS RRB PO admit card 2026 out at ibps.in; exam on November 21, 22 
 SBI Junior Associate Pre Scorecard Details
 The scorecard will contain the following information:
 Candidate's name
 Roll number and registration number
 Examination name
 Overall marks obtained
 Section-wise marks
 Qualifying status
 Candidates must check all the details mentioned on the scorecard carefully. 
 Also read SBI PO mains 2026 result out; check phase 3 dates 
 SBI Clerk main exam dates 2026
 Candidates who qualify in the SBI Clerk prelims examination will be eligible for the mains exam. SBI Clerk Mains Exam 2027 will be held on November 26 and 27. 
 According to the SBI Clerk notification 2026 , the recruitment drive is being conducted for 7,680 regular junior associate vacancies.
